Definition: a shorter (and probably original) form of G1691; me:--I, me, my.
BiblicalUsage: The word is the enclitic me, the small word for myself, and it is everywhere in the Gospels: come unto me, says Jesus, and the leper says, if thou wilt, thou canst make me clean. It is the word of the one who comes to Christ with nothing but need.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that this little word is the whole gospel in miniature: come unto me, make me clean — the sinner brings nothing but himself, and Christ is enough.
